14. Gordon B. Hinckley, “ This Is the Work of the Master ,” Ensign, May 1995, 71. President Hinckley also said: “You have as great an opportunity for satisfaction in the performance of your duty as I do in mine. The progress of this work will be determined by our joint efforts. Whatever your calling, it is as fraught with the same kind of opportunity to accomplish good as is mine. What is really important is that this is the work of the Master. Our work is to go about doing good as did He” (“ This Is the Work of the Master ,” 71). President Thomas S. Monson said: “How does one magnify a calling? Simply by performing the service that pertains to it” (“ Duty Calls ,” 43).
